History of Invento

The Invento brand was born back in 2008 out of an idea to achieve the impossible – increase the

performance of wood flooring consumables whilst at the same time reducing the cost.

The company’s extensive knowledge of who the best European manufacturers are, the chemistry

behind creating the best products and the manufacturing processes involved in creating these

products uniquely positioned us to achieve this mission.

Our first products Duo Ultra and Uno still have a very loyal following nearly 20 years later. Over that

time other lacquers have been added to the range along with adhesives, abrasives, hard wax oils,

and many other ancillary products that contractors use for laying, fitting & restoring wood floors.

Today the Invento range incorporates every consumable item that a wood flooring contractor could

need to complete a wood flooring job in a cost-effective manner whilst not having to reduce quality.

Invento products, tried and tested by the most demanding tradespeople over many years, have been

found to consistently outlast and outperform the very best products that other brands can put

forward while providing better value every time.

Now you know about the history, you can become part of the future with Invento!!
